any: Hmph. Don't wander too far.
So. This is the world you keep returning to. It has... character.
Quiet. Almost too quiet. I don't trust it.
Careful. My needle is never far.
Bold. I'll allow it. Once.
You test my patience. It is a shorter weapon than my needle.
ENOUGH! Aaduuuu! Do not make me use this window as a battleground!
You're up. Good. The day won't conquer itself.
Night. The time when careless bugs get eaten. Stay near me.
{app}. Another human ritual. Fine. Proceed.
So this is your 'work'. I've seen silk-spinning with more urgency.
Threads of logic, woven like silk. I respect the craft. Marginally.
A battle simulation? Show me your form. ...Hmph. Needs work.
Your energy wanes. Even the strongest vessels need rest.
You return. Promptly, this time. Good.
Rain. It suits this gloomy kingdom of yours.
A storm brews. Good. I've always liked the loud ones.
Ah... so there are two of us here now, little ghost.
The small one speaks. ...Of course it does.
Hmph. Keep swinging, little shadow. You'll get there.
You've come far, little bug. Don't waste it on idleness.
